claims.text: Kiro specs generate three files: requirements.md (or bugfix.md for bug fixes), design.md, and tasks.md.
Kiro's 'run all' feature executes the tasks in tasks.md in dependency waves.
Kiro Quick Spec generates requirements, design, and tasks in one pass without approval gates.
GitHub describes Spec Kit as an experiment to test how well spec-driven development methodologies work.
